note: Umair et al. (2025) report homozygous NAV3-associated neurodevelopmental disorder with ambiguous speech explicitly linked to vocal cord involvement, giving the hypothesis clear literature footing.

evidence.text: Umair et al. (2025) reported a homozygous missense NAV3 variant (c.3430T>C; p.Ser1144Pro) associated with neurodevelopmental disorder where a distinctive phenotypic feature was speech impairment linked to vocal cord involvement, unlike previously reported NAV3 cases.

source.title: NAV3 Missense Variant in a Homozygous State: Strengthening Links to Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: However, a distinctive feature in our cohort is ambiguous speech linked to vocal cord … in previous NAV3-related cases, suggesting a novel aspect of the phenotype.

evidence.text: Kakar et al. (2025) characterized five patients from three consanguineous families with biallelic truncating NAV3 variants causing neurodevelopmental disorder, noting both mono-allelic and bi-allelic NAV3 variants in the broader literature.

source.title: Further evidence of biallelic NAV3 variants associated with recessive neurodevelopmental disorder with dysmorphism, developmental delay, intellectual disability …
source.quote: Recently, five bi-allelic and three mono-allelic variants in NAV3 were reported in 12 individuals from eight unrelated families with neurodevelopmental disorder (NDD). Here, we report five patients from three unrelated consanguineous families segregating autosomal recessive NDD.
